title: A final amphibious exercise

paragraphs.text: Before departure, BLT 2/5 conducted a four-day amphibious landing exercise at Kin Beach, Okinawa. The retrospective account does not give its exact dates.

notes: The date bounds are a navigation envelope only; exact exercise dates are not established.
